description: This PHP file defines the class DStDevP which calculates the population standard deviation from a database range, following Excel's DSTDEVP function. It serves as part of a larger spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: DStDevP
classes.description: A class providing a method to evaluate the population standard deviation from database data, adhering to Excel's DSTDEVP function.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the population standard deviation based on filtered database data for given criteria, returning an error if the field is invalid.
